data.body_html:
Plan the ultimate family day on the water in Marbella with a combo that packs in a jet ski, snorkelling, and paddleboarding — all aboard a luxury Mangusta 80. This 4-hour charter from Puerto Banús gives you and up to 11 others the run of a 24-metre yacht, with a free jet ski thrown in, plus snorkel gear and a paddleboard at no extra cost. From €4,719, the price covers everything: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT. No hidden extras, just a full day of fun for the whole family.

Why choose a family boat day with jetski, snorkel & paddleboard?

This experience is designed for families who want variety without the hassle. Instead of booking separate activities, you get everything in one package: a fast jet ski ride, calm snorkelling in clear coves, and paddleboarding along the coast. The Mangusta 80 is spacious enough for everyone to relax between activities, with a large sundeck and shaded saloon. The skipper handles all navigation and safety, so you can focus on having fun.

What’s included in the price

  • Licensed skipper (English and Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the boat and jet ski
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, sandwiches)
  • Snorkel masks and fins (one set per person)
  • Paddleboard (stand-up paddleboard)
  • One jet ski (Yamaha VX or similar)
  • Insurance and safety equipment (life jackets for all ages)
  • 21% Spanish IVA included

The boat: Mangusta 80

The Mangusta 80 is a 24-metre open yacht built for social days on the water. It has a top speed of around 30 knots, a large cockpit with seating, a forward sunpad, and a wet bar. With capacity for 12 passengers, there’s plenty of room for kids to move around. The yacht departs from Puerto Banús, the iconic marina in Marbella. Read more about our boat rental Marbella options.

Typical itinerary for the 4-hour charter

Departure is from Puerto Banús. After a safety briefing, you’ll cruise east towards the Marbella coastline. Stops include Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, two sheltered coves perfect for snorkelling and paddleboarding. The jet ski can be used in designated areas near the boat. You’ll also pass landmarks like the Golden Mile and La Concha mountain. The skipper will adjust the route based on sea conditions and your preferences.

What to bring and what to expect

Bring swimwear, sunscreen (reef-safe recommended), a towel, and sunglasses. All equipment is provided, but you can bring your own snorkel mask if you prefer. The boat has a fresh water shower to rinse off after swimming. The skipper will provide life jackets for all ages, including children. Expect a relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere with no rushing.

Pricing and booking details

The Mangusta 80 family boat day costs €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours. Longer charters (6 or 8 hours) are available — contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. A deposit secures your date, with the balance payable on the day. Cancellation policy: full refund if cancelled 48 hours before departure. Book directly through our boat rental Marbella page.
